scope: Independent finalized Celo settlement, fixed signature expiry and durable payer identity before the first paid call

covered: Signed expiry never exceeds the persisted quote expiry
Expired quotes are refused before dispatch
Signed HTTP errors retain the reservation
Finalized chain time, not local time, controls unused expiry
A consumed nonce without the exact successful transfer is not proof
Verified cost and receipt are separate from provider claims
Usable output survives uncertain or unpaid settlement
Repeated reconciliation cannot release or charge twice

limitations: No real usebuy service has been purchased or delivered yet
No end-to-end real payment receipt has exercised the new reconciliation path
Cancelled or unverifiable authorizations remain reserved for operator review
Migration 0024 refuses any pre-existing legacy purchase rows for independent audit
Hosted signup, runner and sponsored payments remain disabled
